summary: End-to-end testing of the 'Constructoras (clientes)' feature (backend CRUD + public endpoints + Proyecto.constructora_id persistence + Admin UI + Landing UI + New Project modal select). 11/11 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend Playwright flow confirms: landing section renders with the heading 'Constructoras que confían en nosotros', admin login → Usuarios shows the Constructoras block, adding a constructora with PNG logo persists and appears in both the admin list and the public landing (with a working logo src), and the ProjectFormContent modal exposes the project-constructora-select populated with the newly created constructora. All test-ids from the request are present and working.

minor.issue: Sending only {constructora_id: null} returns 400 (endpoint requires additional fields to consider it an update). Non-blocking: null-unlink is still handled via DELETE-constructora cascade which works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/constructoras.py is clean and well-scoped (~190 lines). Uses GridFS via services.storage abstraction; excludes _id in projections/responses; delete cascades constructora_id → null on proyectos as required.
MIME/extension validation uses both content_type and filename extension (defensive). MAX 3MB enforced.
LandingPage.jsx builds logo URL as `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${c.logo_url}` where c.logo_url already starts with '/api/...'. Works but could be simplified.
ProjectFormContent select correctly binds formData.constructora_id and includes an empty option (— Sin constructora asignada —).

Non-blocking: PUT /api/proyectos rejects {constructora_id: null} alone with 400 'Sin cambios'-style validation upstream; if a user un-links a constructora from the UI they need at least one other field change. Consider allowing partial patch with explicit null.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: landing, admin CRUD add, list appearance, landing render, project modal select populated)

seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up: TEST_Constructora_Auto, TEST_UI_Constructora, TEST_ToDelete constructoras and TEST_Proj_Constructora, TEST_Proj_Unlink projects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_constructoras.py covers full CRUD + validations (large logo >3MB, bad format pdf, empty name) + public endpoint + logo binary + proyecto.constructora_id persistence + delete cascade. Uses PIL to generate PNGs; multipart/form-data for POST/PUT. Auth via /api/auth/login returning access_token. Project creation requires: nombre, tipo, ubicacion, coordenadas{lat,lng}, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin_planeada.
